comparison.objective: Depin one connector terminal vs locate a hidden wall screw with a magnetic stud finder.
comparison.physical_skill: Contact-rich latch release and extraction vs maintaining a flat sliding search contact and releasing upon magnetic capture.
comparison.success_condition: Terminal exits intact and alone vs finder hangs still on a hidden screw.
comparison.reason: The stud-finding task tests exploratory sliding and magnetic localization, not insertion beneath a latch.
